annotations.title: Plan a whole system from a brief (built after review)

description: Plans a whole PROJECT in TabTree from a brief, in one call, and lets the user build it with one click in the app. You write a blueprint: the work (each item human, agent or pair — an agent or pair item needs a deliverable and acceptance criteria), Build (project work) and Run (recurring) sides, epics, roles, milestones, and the systems the project needs (crm, launch, hiring, ops — each becomes a sheet + pipeline tab). TabTree creates an empty board named after the project and shows the plan on the user's library screen; the user adjusts the horizon, how much Claude takes, the systems and who holds each role, then clicks Build it. Nothing appears until TabTree is open on one of the user's devices. Never invent people, e-mail addresses, clients or figures: only names written in the brief. Work-item ids: a-z, 0-9 and _ only. Dates: "w1"… within the horizon, or a real day YYYY-MM-DD.

goal.description: What must be true at the end — one sentence. It becomes the sprint goal.

who.description: A name or e-mail WRITTEN in the brief; omit otherwise.

space.description: The space to create the project in (a name). Default: Personal.

seed.description: Records NAMED in the brief (a lead, a candidate, a ticket).

system.description: Only for an item that IS a record of that system.
